prompt: Show our top five products by revenue and, separately, by distinct customers in Q1 2026.

answer.markdown:
### Calvin Klein Top Products: Q1 2026 (Jan 1, 2026 – Mar 31, 2026 UTC)

During Q1 2026, Calvin Klein recorded qualifying sales across two distinct products. Both products are ranked below by revenue and by distinct customer count [E1].

*Scope & Metric Caveat: Qualifying sales exclude cancelled and returned items and orders. Revenue is calculated as the sum of `sale_price`.*

---

#### 1. Top Products by Revenue

| Rank | Product ID | Product Name | Revenue | Distinct Customers |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | 1 | Alpha jeans | 575.00 | 1 |
| 2 | 3 | Alpha top | 210.00 | 4 |

---

#### 2. Top Products by Distinct Customers

| Rank | Product ID | Product Name | Distinct Customers | Revenue |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | 3 | Alpha top | 4 | 210.00 |
| 2 | 1 | Alpha jeans | 1 | 575.00 |

*(Note: Only two products had qualifying sales during this period.)*

evidence.sql:
WITH q1_sales AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    SUM(sale_price) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS distinct_customers
  FROM sales
  WHERE purchased_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND purchased_at < '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY product_id, product_name
),
top_rev AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    total_revenue,
    distinct_customers,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, product_id ASC) as rank_rev
  FROM q1_sales
),
top_cust AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    total_revenue,
    distinct_customers,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC, total_revenue DESC, product_id ASC) as rank_cust
  FROM q1_sales
)
SELECT 'revenue' as ranking_type, rank_rev as rank, product_id, product_name, total_revenue, distinct_customers
FROM top_rev
WHERE rank_rev <= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT 'customers' as ranking_type, rank_cust as rank, product_id, product_name, total_revenue, distinct_customers
FROM top_cust
WHERE rank_cust <= 5
ORDER BY ranking_type, rank
evidence.definitions: scoped-retail-v1; sales contains qualifying item purchases, excluding Cancelled/Returned at both item and order level. transactions contains all current statuses. Revenue uses sale_price; orders and customers require distinct IDs. Brand scope applies before joins and history. purchased_at is the item's created_at. Use UTC half-open periods. Current statuses cannot reconstruct historical status changes. Currency is not specified. Customer geography is available only through query_state_summary.
